tools.name: financial_evidence_topics
tools.description: List supported topics and their fixed public raw-JSON routes without network access.

tools.name: financial_evidence_route
tools.description: Resolve one or more financial research topics to fixed public raw-JSON sources without fetching them.

tools.name: financial_evidence_fetch
tools.description: Fetch bounded untrusted read-only JSON from fixed LiquiLens, Undertow, Seiche, and Palimpsest routes. Status reports transport only; evidence is not evaluated and Evidence Carrier verification is not performed.
